# Synthetic Storage Records

## Backup recovery

Encrypted backup recovery uses `vault-kb-02` and the documented restore key.

## Current retention

Current backup retention keeps snapshots for 35 days.
Current retention policy records 35 days for the synthetic corpus.

## Historical retention

Historical backup retention kept snapshots for 14 days.

## Canonical backup destination

The canonical backup destination is `vault-kb-02`.
